overview_description.description:
How do you discover the future of software engineering?
We're building it.

Language models can write code better than most humans, but they often destroy codebases due to poor context management and understanding. The future isn't about replacing developers - it's about empowering them to orchestrate AI agents effectively.

We're creating systems that enable small teams of developers to manage large-scale agent operations across the entire software lifecycle - from development to QA, security audits, and deployment.

It's called Nozomio.

product.name: Nia AI Code Agent
product.description: An AI-powered agent that understands and interacts with your codebase via API, IDE, or command line interface.

product.name: Nozomio Platform
product.description: A platform designed to manage AI agents working with software codebases, focusing on context management and code understanding.

product.name: Nia AI for Code Understanding
product.description: An AI tool designed to understand software codebases to assist developers in managing and debugging code.

product.name: Nia API
product.description: An API that integrates Nia's AI code understanding capabilities into custom applications and workflows.

product.name: Nia CLI (Command-Line Interface)
product.description: A command-line tool that allows users to access Nia's code understanding features directly from their terminal.

product.name: AI Debugging (coming soon)
product.description: A forthcoming tool intended to assist developers in identifying and resolving software bugs using AI.
